sections.title: Business Goal

requirements.text: Separate Infrastructure MVP evidence, Goal 012 planning scope, and later functional implementation scope in the specification.
Preserve stable requirement and acceptance criteria identifiers for later traceability work.

sections.summary: Scope Infrastructure MVP scope The Infrastructure MVP has already established the local Oracle lab structure, controlled install workflow, smoke tests, review workflow, and release packaging skeleton. Those infrastructure capabilities remain the foundation for later functional work. Goal 012 placeholder scope Goal 012 updates this semantic specification and supporting planning documentation only. It does not change DB source, scripts, tests, packaging output, Docker behavior, or Oracle runtime state. Future functional iteration scope Later goals may turn approved requirements into versioned SQL files, tests, review evidence, and release package content. Those later goals must remain separate from Goal 012.
sections.title: Scope

requirements.text: Keep all release-management database implementation work out of Goal 012, including SQL tables, PL/SQL, views, triggers, business seed data, and deployment logic.

sections.summary: Out of Scope Goal 012 does not create tables, packages, views, triggers, deployment logic, runtime validation, REST, ORDS, APEX, or UI. It also does not add secrets, connect to organizational databases, or perform ad-hoc DDL or DML.
sections.title: Out of Scope

requirements.text: Treat RELEASE_REQUESTS, RELEASE_ITEMS, RELEASE_ENVIRONMENTS, RELEASE_STATUSES, RELEASE_APPROVALS, and RELEASE_EXECUTION_LOG as future planning candidates only.
